title: A map of cis -regulatory modules and constituent transcription factor binding sites in 80% of the mouse genome
authors: Pengyu Ni; David Wilson; Zhengchang Su
one_liner_zh: 该文整合小鼠全基因组ChIP-seq数据绘制顺式调控模块与TF结合位点图谱，属TF-DNA结合位点的大规模注释与资源构建，但缺乏AI或物理模拟建模方法，深度有限。
abstract: Mouse is probably the most important model organism to study mammal biology and human diseases. A better understanding of the mouse genome will help understand the human genome, biology and diseases. However, despite the recent progress, characterization of the regulatory sequences in the mouse genome is still far from complete, limiting its use to understand the regulatory sequences in the human genome. Here, by integrating binding peaks in 9,060 transcription factor (TF) ChIP-seq datasets that cover 79.9% of the mouse mappable genome using an efficient pipeline, we were able to partition these binding peak-covered genome regions into a cis -regulatory module (CRM) candidate (CRMC) set and a non-CRMC sets. The CRMCs contain 912,197 putative CRMs and 38,554,729 TF binding sites (TFBSs) islands, covering 55.5% and 24.4% of the mappable genome, respectively. The CRMCs tend to be under strongly evolutionary constraints, indicating that they are likely cis -regulatory; while the non-CRMCs are largely selectively neutral, indicating that they are unlikely cis -regulatory. Based on evolutionary profiles of the genome positions, we further estimated that 63.8% and 27.4% of the mouse genome might code for CRMs and TFBSs, respectively. Validation using experimental data suggests that at least most of the CRMCs are authentic. Thus, this unprecedentedly comprehensive map of CRMs and TFBSs can be a good resource to guide experimental studies of regulatory genomes in mice and humans.
abstract_zh: 小鼠可能是研究哺乳动物生物学和人类疾病最重要的模式生物。更深入地理解小鼠基因组将有助于理解人类基因组、生物学及疾病。然而，尽管近期有所进展，小鼠基因组中调控序列的表征仍远未完成，这限制了其用于理解人类基因组中调控序列的能力。在此，通过整合覆盖小鼠可定位基因组79.9%的9,060个转录因子（TF）ChIP-seq数据集中的结合峰，并采用高效流程，我们能够将这些结合峰覆盖的基因组区域划分为顺式调控模块（CRM）候选集（CRMC）和非CRMC集。CRMCs包含912,197个推定CRMs和38,554,729个TF结合位点（TFBSs）岛，分别覆盖可定位基因组的55.5%和24.4%。CRMCs倾向于受到强烈的进化约束，表明它们很可能具有顺式调控功能；而非CRMCs则大多处于选择性中性状态，表明它们不太可能具有顺式调控作用。基于基因组位置的进化谱，我们进一步估计小鼠基因组中可能有63.8%和27.4%分别编码CRMs和TFBSs。通过实验数据验证表明，至少大多数CRMCs是真实的。因此，这一前所未有的全面CRMs和TFBSs图谱可作为指导小鼠和人类调控基因组实验研究的良好资源。
